_note: Gas on the floor as clouds of puffs (src/vfx/gas.gd). A cloud of radius r has one puff per px_per_puff px of it (min_puffs..max_puffs), each about puff_share of r across (puff_min..puff_max world px at art 2, scaled with the art pixel). Puffs burst out from where the gas appears at spawn_speed px/s, fresh ones small and at full density, swelling from grow_from of their size to full over grow_time s (fresh gas is at its thickest), push each other apart (spread) until they are overlap times their summed radii apart (below 1: they keep overlapping, one cloud), are held softly in their zone (hold, past hold_from of r), roll slowly (drift px/s), slow down (damping 1/s) and stop at walls, where what runs into them fans out along the wall (wall_fan: share of the speed into the wall turned along it). A thrown cloud (an emitted one, not a zone) travels as a whole along its push, slowing by travel_damping 1/s, and stops and slides at walls, so it piles up against them and gathers in corners; its puffs keep pace with it (their push is scaled by damping / travel_damping) and burst out only thrown_burst as fast, so it flies as one glob. Blasts push them away at blast_speed px/s and thin them (blast_thin); actors part them (part_speed); shots cut through them (cut_speed). An ended cloud thins out over fade s, its outer puffs first (edge_fade). Density shows by the 4x4 dither (dense = solid), never by alpha; colours by role: hi the lit top, lite and body the cloud, shade its lower part, deep its dark underside. User request 2026-10-30: gas as physics (flows round walls, gathers in corners, blown away by blasts).
